data.body: Live CI evidence: GitHub Actions run 44969051673 (verify-identity.yml, event schedule on main, 2026-11-22 00:56 UTC = 2026-11-21 16:56 PST, head f204965134f, which contains this fix d5f10d1d2c8 and scarlet-unsocial-limpkin 8469f0a5ede). Every step succeeded. Step 9 'verify-opcert (required-environment op-cert gate)' ran the added `git fetch --filter=blob:none --no-tags origin '+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main'`, then rebar verify-opcert printed 'trust configuration from refs/remotes/origin/main:rebar.toml' and '0 satisfied, 5770 unsatisfied (5770 closed ticket(s) in scope)' with 'advisory — no required environment configured', exit 0 (advisory, as intended: this repo sets no required environment). Note: the workflow's push trigger excludes main (branches-ignore), so main is covered by the 6-hourly schedule, not by push. That run predates floating-guiltless-oxpecker (8a35d8720a4); the next scheduled run covers it.
